findings.reason: the node must be marked landed and the plan's "gains one untransformed accessor" clause dropped, or the next dispatch would re-add `raw_series` and re-migrate the reader.
findings.text: the plan's open node `jtmm-observation-time-alignment` is described as "`VirtualZarrView` gains one untransformed accessor, which returns a rule's source values and that channel's own time base with no compiled transform applied" (plan §6, "only `jtmm-observation-time-alignment` remains open here"), but that accessor already exists as `VirtualZarrView.raw_series` at `imas_ambix/data/virtual_zarr.py:146`, whose docstring is the plan's own sentence verbatim, and `read_signal_map_observation` at `imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py:851` already reads through it (commit df71829c, "read the sign observation through the view's raw accessor", landed 2026-10-06T19:48Z, 35 min before this review) — a design review run against the codebase would tell the author to rebuild a live mechanism.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the design extends existing deep modules (`eddb_remote.RemoteEddbExtractor` dispatches on request type, `eddb.write_channel` gains a sibling grid writer, `VirtualZarrView`, `cocos_convention`, `gs/artifact_resolution`) rather than spreading behaviour across many shallow wrappers; the EQDB transport adds one record type behind the existing extractor seam.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the plan names its one live duplicate and retires it: `imas_ambix/data/tokamap_export.py:147` `_cocos_transformation` duplicates `imas_ambix/data/transform_engine.py:411` `_target_cocos_transformation`, and node `jtmm-tokamap-jt60sa` makes the exporter take each factor from the engine, retiring the private copy; the pin constants, `mast_angle_to_canonical` and the angle entries of `MAST_TO_COCOS_17_FACTORS` are all named for retirement against their owners.
rubric_items.interface_budget: public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; pass — every adding section accounts for its surface in its own text (§2 exporter "None of the seven retires anything, because ambix has no exporter"; §6 EQDB "three new public types … retire nothing, because no equilibrium-database request type exists"; §6 `measure_convention` and `read_signal_map_observation` each retire/merge a predecessor; §7 pin table "retires three public definitions and their re-export, and adds one"; §7 frozen shot set "retires and merges nothing, because it is a new shot-set identity").
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan searched the two named codebases exhaustively and cites the owner each node extends, but one open node (`jtmm-observation-time-alignment`) proposes adding an untransformed accessor that already exists at HEAD.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — every wrapper the plan adds states why the existing machinery cannot be extended instead (the EQDB request type is not channel-shaped so `ChannelRequest`/`ChannelRecord` are not widened; the tokamap exporter is kept out of the loaders so they do not learn tokamap's format; the sign-report readers hand a cohort to the existing scorer rather than adding a second scorer).
